description: Western Province Provincial Council - Notify the Special Statute of Waste Management of Western Province
categorisation: The gazette content primarily consists of a new statute ("Special Statute of Waste Management of Western Province") that establishes legal regulations, offences, penalties, and procedural rules for waste management. It creates new legal provisions, defines offences, and outlines enforcement mechanisms, which falls squarely under the Legal/Regulatory classification (Type 5) for new laws, acts, and regulatory frameworks.
